# Commission Payouts Clause

Prepares keyed commission payouts through ordinary Documents preparation. `commission` defaults to `/commission`; collection and template bindings determine payout placement and construction. `preparePayout` accepts only `key` and `amountMinor`, with integer amount from 1 through 100,000,000. A new destination is refused when the collection already has 20 entries or commission funds are reserved by an unresolved payout.

The action passes the amount as an allowed prepared field. It emits `Commission Payout Opened` only for `acceptedNew`; a matching retry does not emit another opening. The event requests reservation processing and does not prove that the recipient has received funds. Provision, cancellation, access and readiness retain the ordinary Documents checks.

Configuration references: `bindings.collection` is configured by the caller/type context; `bindings.commission` defaults to `/commission`; `bindings.parties` is configured by the caller/type context; `bindings.sources` is configured by the caller/type context; `bindings.template` is configured by the caller/type context; `parameters.allowedFields` declares `["amountMinor"]`; `parameters.parties` declares `[]`.
